research_control_plan.policy: Round691 may only preregister PIT financial reporting timeliness candidates for research screening. Portfolio grids, promotion, sign/window tuning, mixed-window harvesting, live trading, and final-holdout reads remain blocked.

data_source_plan.available_date_rule: Use the first valid trading date strictly after ann_date or an explicitly later effective date; same-day announcement trading is blocked.
data_source_plan.provider_limit_policy: Use local processed PIT statement cache; do not download or extend source data during candidate-plan gate.

cn_stock_data_manifest_result.warning_policy: Warnings must be carried into prescreen documentation and cannot be interpreted as alpha evidence.

candidate_generation_policy.multiple_testing_accounting_rule: Every formula, sign, lag, horizon, or window variant must be preregistered and counted before screening.

hibernated_families.reason: Prior forecast/express disagreement prescreen produced zero usable research leads.
Prior realized statement formula mutations lacked robust residual leads and must not be treated as this PIT timeliness family.

candidates.formula: negative cross-sectional rank of report_lag_days = ann_date - end_date, evaluated only from the first valid trading date after ann_date
candidates.hypothesis_source: Round690 PIT financial statement cache with ann_date and report-period end_date; disclosure-timeliness and information-opacity literature.
candidates.economic_rationale: Shorter reporting lag can proxy stronger internal controls, lower opacity, and faster information release when shifted to a later tradable signal date.

candidates.formula: same-quarter year-over-year improvement in report_lag_days, where higher score means the current report arrives faster than four quarters earlier
candidates.hypothesis_source: Round690 PIT financial statement cache; reporting process improvement and disclosure-quality intuition.
candidates.economic_rationale: Improving reporting discipline may indicate better operating cadence or disclosure quality, but must be tested with industry and style residual controls.

candidates.formula: negative trailing eight-quarter standard deviation of report_lag_days, shifted to the first valid trading date after ann_date
candidates.hypothesis_source: Round690 PIT financial statement cache; stable reporting cadence as a disclosure-process quality proxy.
candidates.economic_rationale: Stable reporting cadence can reduce uncertainty and event-timing noise, but may be redundant with industry and company maturity controls.

candidates.formula: frozen equal-weight composite of timely reporting and PIT-safe realized quality or cash-conversion rank, used only when required columns are present
candidates.hypothesis_source: Round690 PIT financial statement cache; accounting-quality and timely-disclosure joint hypothesis.
candidates.economic_rationale: Timeliness is more plausible as an alpha source when paired with realized quality, reducing the risk of measuring only a calendar artifact.

candidates.formula: negative score for extreme late reporters after their announcement is observable; no same-day or period-end-only signal is allowed
candidates.hypothesis_source: Round690 PIT financial statement cache; late disclosure as an information-opacity, weak-control, or operating-friction risk proxy.
candidates.economic_rationale: Very late reporting may identify opacity or governance friction that is compensated through weaker subsequent returns after controls.

safety: Research-to-review only. No broker connection, no account reads, no order placement, no live trading.
